name: orion-infra Terraform
originalTriggers: parameters become workflow_dispatch inputs; 'environments' (object) becomes a JSON-array string input

taskMap.github: azure/login (OIDC) + terraform init/plan/apply in run steps with ARM_USE_OIDC
taskMap.note: the source's plan template exports ARM_CLIENT_SECRET from the service principal key; OIDC removes that secret. The task analyser does not list this task for this pipeline because it sits inside a conditional insertion
cluster and resource group come from new variables ORION_AKS_PROD_CLUSTER and ORION_AKS_PROD_RESOURCE_GROUP: the service connection orion-aks-prod does not expose them in the seed
used by the steps/terraform-plan.yml template, not by the pipeline file itself

templates.handledBy: inlined as the Terraform plan and Publish plan steps of the plan job (matrix over environments)

acceptedWarnings.why: The source gives these jobs no environment and keeps the credentials at repository level (Azure variable groups are not environment-scoped). Scoping them to a GitHub environment is a hardening choice for the reviewer; it would add approvals and deployment records the source does not have.

notes: The compile-time 'each environment' stages become one matrix job; Apply_Prod depended only on Plan_staging in Azure but needs the whole plan matrix here.
The remote state uses the azurerm backend: it needs use_oidc (or ARM_USE_OIDC, set) and the identity must have access to the state storage.
The second checkout of the templates repository is dropped because the template is inlined; the working directory is terraform/ instead of orion-infra/terraform.
Environment infra-prod carries the approval (Release Managers, gina, 24 h timeout) and branch control (main) in the source: configure them on the GitHub environment.
Group secret ARM_CLIENT_SECRET is not referenced by the YAML and is not created (OIDC replaces it).
